exposure: switch from intravenous (IV) vedolizumab to subcutaneous (SC) vedolizumab maintenance treatment
outcome: time to discontinuation of SC vedolizumab
cohort: Patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) who had received intravenous vedolizumab for at least 4 months.
finding: Switching from intravenous to subcutaneous vedolizumab maintenance treatment is effective in patients with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, though a portion switched back due to adverse events or needle fear.
